question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **out.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"out"** means away from the inside or center. (बाहर)
 
• **"out" **is used to indicate movement away from a particular place or position.
 
 
• **Example: **The cat jumped out of the window.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that mom instructed Kasturi to play outside and not in the garden. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for the blank is **'out'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **out**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **of **(का): Expressing the relationship between a part and a whole.

 
 
• **Example:** The cover of the book is torn.
 
 
 
• **in **(में): Expressing the situation of something that is or appears to be enclosed or surrounded by something else.
 
 
• **Example: **She is in the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **from** (से): Indicating the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.
 
 
• **Example:** He traveled from New York to Los Angeles.
